#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string str;
    std::cin >> n >> str;

    int maxSize = 0;
    int currentSize = 0;
    int wordCount = 0;
    bool inside = false;
    int wordFlag = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        char c = str[i];

        if (c == '(') {
            inside = true;
            if (currentSize != 0) {
                maxSize = std::max(maxSize, currentSize);
                currentSize = 0;
            }
            wordFlag = 0;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            inside = false;
            if (currentSize != 0) {
                maxSize = std::max(maxSize, currentSize);
                currentSize = 0;
            }
        }

        if (inside) {
            if (wordFlag != 1) {
                if (c != '_' && c != '(' && c != ')') {
                    wordCount++;
                    wordFlag = 1;
                }
            }
            if (c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')') {
                wordFlag = 0;
            }
        } else {
            if (c != '_' && c != ')' && c != '(') {
                currentSize++;
                if (i == n - 1) {
                    maxSize = std::max(maxSize, currentSize);
                }
            } else {
                if (currentSize != 0) {
                    maxSize = std::max(maxSize, currentSize);
                    currentSize = 0;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << maxSize << " " << wordCount << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
